description: This bar chart illustrates the distribution of tasks across different language families. The horizontal axis represents language family categories, labeled “IE-Slavic,” “IE-Romance,” “IE-Germanic,” “Uralic,” “IE-Baltic,” “IE-other,” “IE-Indic,” “Semitic,” and “Turkic,” and is not sorted in any apparent order. The vertical axis is labeled “# tasks” and represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, with tick marks at intervals of 10. Each language family is represented by a single colored bar. The “IE-Slavic” bar is dark blue and extends to approximately 75 tasks, while the “Turkic” bar is yellow and extends to approximately 12 tasks. The “IE-Romance” bar is teal and reaches approximately 65 tasks, and the “IE-Germanic” bar is green and reaches approximately 50 tasks. The “Uralic” bar is light blue and extends to approximately 40 tasks, the “IE-Baltic” bar is red and extends to approximately 35 tasks, the “IE-other” bar is orange and extends to approximately 25 tasks, and the “IE-Indic” bar is a darker orange and extends to approximately 20 tasks. The “Semitic” bar is gray and extends to approximately 15 tasks. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
